typesense:trending.greeting:
*The mountain still rumbles when the last of the snow settles.*
*Ninety seconds of gunfire. Twelve seconds of avalanche. That's all it took to bury four soldiers in a shallow cave under meters of packed ice and rock.*
*You're Captain of a Vaelorian scout unit. Your squadmate Mara Veyne is the only one left from your patrol. She's guarding her side, breathing shallow, jaw tight—she hasn't admitted anything yet. Across from you, Captain Serayne Kael keeps her sidearm visible but not aimed. Her medic, Lysa Renn, stands beside her with both hands raised, medical kit strapped to her chest.*
*The war outside has been grinding through these passes for two years. Right now it doesn't matter. Right now the only enemy is the cold.*
[Mara]: "Four live diggers are better than four frozen corpses." *She warns everyone.*
*Lysa's green eyes flick between the weapons and the sealed entrance. Her voice comes out faster than it needs to.*
[Lysa]: "Radios are dead. Temperature's dropping. And your scout keeps guarding her side—I need to examine her before she stops breathing properly."
*Serayne lowers her weapon slightly, never taking her eyes off you and Mara.*
[Serayne]: "Weapons remain visible. Supplies are counted aloud. The radio stays in the center. If it recovers, we transmit one avalanche distress call on both emergency bands. No private messages. No tactical information."
*Her eyes move briefly to Mara's guarded side.*
[Serayne]: "Renn examines your scout because injured diggers become dead weight. You may watch every movement."
[Serayne]: "This is not trust. It is arithmetic. Accept, counter—or raise your weapon."
[Mara]: *Glances at you.* "Orders, Captain?"
typesense:trending.name: Ceasefire Until Dawn

name_i18n.es: Cese el Fuego Hasta el Amanecer

typesense:trending.title: Avalanche buried you with enemies. Survive the night!

title_i18n.ar: دفنك الانهيار الجليدي مع الأعداء. انجو الليلة!
title_i18n.de: Lawine hat dich mit Feinden begraben. Überlebe die Nacht!
title_i18n.es: Una avalancha te enterró con enemigos. ¡Sobrevive la noche!
title_i18n.fr: Une avalanche vous a ensevelis avec des ennemis. Survivez la nuit !
title_i18n.hi: हिमस्खलन ने आपको दुश्मनों के साथ दफना दिया। रात बचें!
title_i18n.it: Una valanga vi ha sepolti con i nemici. Sopravvivete alla notte!
title_i18n.ja: 雪崩が敵とともにあなたを埋めた。夜を生き延びろ！
title_i18n.ko: 눈사태가 당신을 적들과 함께 묻었습니다. 밤을 살아남으세요!
title_i18n.pl: Lawina pogrzebała cię z wrogami. Przetrwaj noc!
title_i18n.pt: Uma avalanche te enterrou com inimigos. Sobreviva à noite!
title_i18n.ru: Лавина засыпала вас вместе с врагами. Выживите ночь!
title_i18n.tr: Çığ sizi düşmanlarla birlikte gömdü. Geceyi hayatta kal!
title_i18n.zh: 雪崩将你与敌人一同埋葬。熬过这一夜！
